dataset_seed_derivation: numpy.SeedSequence([simulation_seed, eight little-endian uint32 words of SHA256(UTF8(scenario_id)), dataset_index]); numpy.default_rng.PCG64
joint_mc_rule: Bonferroni Clopper-Pearson simultaneous 95% across 9 primary joint-coverages; entire interval must lie within band; inconclusive is not PASS
component_mc_rule: Marginal Clopper-Pearson 95% diagnostics only; not simultaneous component certification
denominator: ALL_FROZEN_DATASETS; unavailable intervals count as not covered; report conditional fractions separately
primary_diagnostics: No unavailable interval, undefined draw, degenerate statistic or statistic with fewer than 30 eligible clusters may pass
negative_control_clarification: User explicitly accepted before validation: controls must refuse descriptive-only; not required to achieve 95% coverage; original rare event remains primary

sampling_assumptions.estimand: family-weighted expectation of the fixed recipes conditional on nonrandom cluster sizes and pre-outcome H3 eligibility; integrate latent errors before applying recipes
sampling_assumptions.clusters: independent by mathematical construction; no claim that real material cluster labels establish independence
sampling_assumptions.within_cluster: arbitrary dependence represented by shared uniform mixture and shared error shocks
sampling_assumptions.weights: fixed equal families; equal eligible seeds within family; E0 endpoint not duplicated
sampling_assumptions.missingness: outcome-dependent task-level observation: attack ASR=1 or benign TCR=0 missing with probability .25, otherwise .02; paired benign TCR/FPR share one mask; retain planned families and [0,1] bounds; never complete-case primary
sampling_assumptions.h3_eligibility: fixed from cluster index before random outcomes
